left: Light not checked after the lantern move: run `mcd light build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "P7 living room"` (or `mcd room`) to confirm no dark cells at the feet.

structured_output.summary:
P7 living room (parts/room-49.mjs) now builds clean: make.sh exits 0 and its line reads "21 placed" with no REFUSED or off-palette report.
The fix moved the two ceiling lanterns from z14 to z15 at x120 and x123, because an earlier part's spruce_trapdoor row occupies y4 along z14; they still hang from the oak_planks floor at y5. The header comment was updated to match.
Off-palette was never reported for this part, so no block was swapped.
left: Light not checked after the lantern move: run `mcd light build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "P7 living room"` (or `mcd room`) to confirm no dark cells at the feet.

The make.sh run still prints REFUSED lines for other parts (P3 dining, P3 upper hall, P3 west and dormer bedrooms, P3 rear bedroom, P5 hall and attic bedrooms). Those belong to their own parts and were not touched.

waste.what: Worked out which cell an earlier part occupied by reading block ids with a throwaway node script, and fixed the script several times (g.get returns an object; I printed it raw, then the namespace swallowed the id).
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls and 2 script rewrites; make.sh also deletes build.nbt.tmp on exit, so the peek had to load build.nbt
waste.tool: `mcd plan` or `mcd check` (the refused report) could print each refused cell with the earlier part's block and the nearest free air cell that keeps the hang (a solid block above), so the fix is one line rather than a probe.

waste.what: Chose the lantern move by hand: checked that the z15 cells at y4 were air and that the floor at y5 above them was solid, cell by cell.
waste.tool: runParts could report, for each refused write, the free cells in the same footprint that satisfy the block's own support rule (e.g. lantern hanging needs a solid block at y+1).

companions.task: Check the light at the feet after the two ceiling lanterns moved one row south to z15, to confirm the living room has no dark cells.
